svg.title: Marlborough study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Marlborough; 2: Wairau Valley; 3: Rapaura; 4: Waihopai; 5: Seddon; 6: Blind River; 7: Kekerengu; 8: Blenheim; 9: Hauwai; 10: Fabians Valley; 11: Nelson; 12: Picton

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
